project_protocol.record: one complete 48-hour all-node input window plus one-hour all-node target

environment.opacus_usage: RDPAccountant only; no GradSampleModule or DPOptimizer

gradient_routes.loop: explicit full-window gradient loop; numerical oracle and CPU route
gradient_routes.torch_func: CUDA functional_call + grad_and_value + vmap; cuDNN disabled for GRU
gradient_routes.dropout: both routes execute with dropout=0.1 and finite gradients; masks are independently sampled

mechanism.sampling: independent Bernoulli per client record at each DP step
mechanism.gradient_unit: whole graph-window; all trainable model parameters
mechanism.gradient_clip: per-record global L2 clipping before aggregation
mechanism.noise: per-parameter independent Gaussian noise with std sigma*C added to clipped-gradient sum
mechanism.normalizer: fixed q*N=32, including random non-empty batches of other sizes
mechanism.empty_draw: noise-only gradient and AdamW update; step counted by accountant
mechanism.fedavg_weight: available unique training-window count per client
mechanism.optimizer: AdamW state reset at each client-round, retained within local epoch

accounting.epsilon_label: theoretical ideal-Gaussian Poisson-RDP estimate; not a claim for research PRNG runs

randomness.research_mode: reproducible ordinary PyTorch PRNG; states are stored for research recovery
randomness.privacy_claim_mode: refused before data loading; no insecure fallback
randomness.secure_randomness_work_remaining: integrate and review a cryptographically secure Gaussian RNG and protect its state before any privacy claim

known_limitations: Ordinary PRNG does not support a privacy guarantee.
Window overlap prevents translating window-level privacy to timepoint/user/client privacy.
Scaler fitting, topology/load mask, validation statistics and validation-based selection are outside this conditional training guarantee.
Repeated source curves across clients require composition for the protected underlying unit.
torch.func uses a slow native-GRU fallback and its measured speed should be revisited at the full 32-record batch and full epoch.
DP-SGD does not provide secure aggregation, communication encryption or client identity hiding.
